0022600172.text: The Heat (2-4, 10th in the East and 4th in the Southeast, one game back) head to the Lakers (5-2, 1st in the Pacific) with Miami on a two-game winning streak and a 1-1 road record. Los Angeles will be without Adou Thiero (knee inflammation) and Ziaire Williams (foot), both listed as out. The teams have not met yet this season, and Miami lost both 2025-26 meetings, most recently 134-126 in Miami on March 19, 2026.
